title: The United Compounds Network Database — Network Overview (Public edition)
description: The United Compounds Network ties all 40 compound databases into one deterministic system: ionic salts, oxides and hydroxides, network solids, organic compounds, and coordination complexes — every compound's data scales from its formula unit through lattice, properties, and applications. Five class records map the network.
how_it_works: The network is the database of databases: each member is a full database, and this network database is the map, the cross-reference, and the scaling law that ties them together.
key_points: Deterministic: every member derives from verified base data

title: The United Compounds Network Database — Determinism Spec
description: Determinism contract for the The United Compounds Network Database: every record in every member database derives reproducibly from base data — atomic numbers and CIAAW 2021 atomic weights for matter; quark quantum numbers for quarks. Same inputs, same records, every build. No invented values anywhere in the chain.
how_it_works: The spec is enforced at build: formula parsing, mass derivation, isotopic variants, and hadron composition are all computed, then re-derived independently in the embedded JavaScript demos, which fail the build on any mismatch.
key_points: Base data: atomic weights / quark quantum numbers
